reels.caption:
Milaidhoo Maldives is a hotel that offers a more understated take on an island stay 🌴

Set within the Baa Atoll UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, the resort is surrounded by a protected house reef you can swim to directly from the beach or your villa. It's also just a short distance from Hanifaru Bay, known for its seasonal gatherings of manta rays.

The villas are designed with an open, understated feel, blending indoor and outdoor living with uninterrupted views across the ocean. Everything is spaced out to keep the atmosphere calm and low-key.

💡 Top tip: Spend time exploring the house reef, it's one of the easiest ways to experience the marine life without needing to leave the island.

reels.caption:
Villa Balbiano on Lake Como 😍

Situated on the western shore of Lake Como, Villa Balbiano is an awe-inspiring Italian jewel, an exceptional historical palazzo that once belonged to the famous Cardinal Tolomeo Gallio, who built it at the end of the 16th century and used it as his main residence.

A century later, it was enlarged and embellished by Cardinal Angelo Maria Durini who used the villa to host a gallant and frivolous society where festivals, banquets, and dances followed one another.

Nowadays, Villa Balbiano is the largest private residence on the lake, with extensive gardens and beautiful interiors.

Positioned directly along one of Malibu's most sought-after stretches of sand, this fully renovated beachfront residence pairs approximately 50 feet of ocean frontage with a feature rarely found on the coastline: a private pool overlooking the Pacific.

Completed after a four-year renovation taken fully to the studs, the home was redesigned around openness, natural light, and continuous connection to the water. Walls of glass frame panoramic ocean views throughout nearly 3,000 square feet of interior living space, while expansive beachfront decks extend directly toward the sand below.

The interiors maintain the relaxed scale of a traditional Malibu beach house while introducing a more refined coastal material palette, offered fully furnished with pieces by Jenni Kayne. Four bedrooms and five bathrooms are distributed across a layout designed equally for quiet daily living and large gatherings along the water.

Just moments from Geoffrey's Malibu and Paradise Cove, the property captures a version of beachfront living that has become increasingly difficult to find along the California coast.
